plugins.name: outbound-engine
plugins.description: 35 Claude Code skills that run the outbound block of a GTM system for B2B service companies. A master skill routes the ten-step path with a gate between steps: ICP and personas, signal catalog, list building and enrichment, two-stage scoring, angles and sequence copy, deliverability, pre-launch data check, reply handling and audits, A/B analysis and weekly reporting. Built and battle-tested by Victor Shulga (Fractional CRO).
